facts.title: Three.js Components, Templates & Interactive Shaders | ThreeUI
facts.description: Browse copy-ready Three.js components, complete website templates, WebGL backgrounds, hero sections, UI effects, and source-backed variants.

research.name: ThreeUI
research.note: Catalog of Three.js scenes, WebGL backgrounds, shader buttons and full 3D landing pages, with free community items and paid Pro templates.

effects: Full 3D landing pages such as AURAL headphones and Kage temple scene

unverified: Community component source is public in MengTo/threeui (MIT, 6,813 stars, last commit 2026-09-01); that repository has not yet been researched as a repository entry.
Pro templates cost 299 USD lifetime or 199 USD per year according to the pricing page markup; Pro sources are not in the public repository.
Items were seen as gallery thumbnails, not running scenes.
